analytic_proof_obligations: derive the Hamilton equations in the frozen symmetric gauge
prove the rotating-frame entire flow across all signs of Delta
prove canonical symplecticity and energy conservation
derive the stable signed action normal form
classify bounded subspaces on stable, Jordan, unstable, zero-axial, and free faces
prove active-mode commensurability, minimal periods, and strobe fixed dimensions

flow_contract.axial_flow: z(t)=cos(zeta*t)z0+sin(zeta*t)vz0/zeta with the zeta=0 free limit
flow_contract.canonical_flow: M_c(t)=T_c^{-1} V_c(t) T_c, T_c(q,p)=(q,v), and M_c(t)^T J M_c(t)=J
flow_contract.entire_functions: C=cos(sqrt(Delta)t/2), S=sin(sqrt(Delta)t/2)/(sqrt(Delta)/2), continued by C=1,S=t at Delta=0 and by cosh/sinh for Delta<0

headline: The ideal Penning trap has an exact six-dimensional symplectic flow, a sharp magnetic-confinement/Jordan/instability atlas, signed mode actions, and a complete resonance and strobe classification.

model_contract.parameters: c is signed cyclotron frequency; zeta>=0 is axial frequency

nonclaims: No literature-priority or experimental-performance claim is made.
Clean resonant tori are not replaced by isolated primitive orbits.
The natural Penning Hamiltonian is not a Hilbert--Polya operator and supplies no target divisor.

orbit_contract.closed_orbit_gate: a nonstationary stable-chamber orbit is closed iff its active labeled modes in (omega_+,omega_-,zeta) are rationally commensurate
orbit_contract.critical_strobe: the radial fixed dimension is two only when c*t/2 is in 2*pi*Z; the Jordan direction never fixes
orbit_contract.minimal_period: if active frequencies are integer multiples n_j*g with gcd(n_j)=1, T_min=2*pi/g
orbit_contract.stable_strobe_fixed_dimension: with labeled (f1,f2,f3)=(omega_+,omega_-,zeta), including coincident values, dim Fix M(t)=2*#{j: f_j*t in 2*pi*Z}
orbit_contract.zero_axial_strobe: for c!=0 the fixed dimension is three, plus two when abs(c)*t is in 2*pi*Z

proof_contract.quantization_boundary: the canonical ideal-trap quantization is natural but its signed magnetron ladder is not promoted to a target spectrum or determinant
proof_contract.scope: ideal axially symmetric trap only; no imperfections, damping, many-body effects, or experimental accuracy claim

regime_contract.critical: zeta>0 and Delta=0: generic radial amplitude grows linearly; bounded iff v0=-i*c*u0/2
regime_contract.stable: zeta>0 and Delta>0: every orbit is bounded
regime_contract.unstable: zeta>0 and Delta<0: generic radial growth rate sqrt(-Delta)/2; the forward-stable radial plane has v0=-(sqrt(-Delta)/2+i*c/2)u0
regime_contract.zero_axial: zeta=0,c!=0: Landau cyclotron plus a fixed guiding centre and free axial drift
